name: hukuhaka-memory-audit
description: Audit Codex local memories for stale, duplicated, conflicting, or overly specific engineering context without editing generated memory files directly.

interface.shortDescription: Review stale or oversized Codex memory safely.
interface.longDescription: Review retained context for durable value and current evidence, propose precise cleanup, and submit approved changes through the host's supported memory update mechanism. A separate hook suggests review when memory size crosses a threshold; generated memory files are never hand-edited.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-memory-audit to audit Codex local memories for stale, duplicated, or overly specific engineering context.
